spans.s:
f. (-ष्ठिः)
A kernel, a stone.
E.
अ neg. स्था to remain, इन् aff.

f. (-ला)
1 A round pebble or stone.
2 A globular swelling below the navel, produced by wind.
3 Contusion.
E.
अस्थि a bone, ला to bring, (to resemble,) क aff.

mn. (-वान्-वत्)
The knee.
E.
अस्थि a bone, and मतुप् poss. aff.

f. (-का)
A pebble.
E.
कन् added to the last, fem. form.
